facts.fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 11 October 2025 the decrees creating the Centre National de Cybersécurité (CNAC) as a public administrative establishment and approving its statutes, to coordinate national cybersecurity strategy including critical systems.
Le Sahel reports a panellist at the April 2026 Niger IGF saying Niger 's'est doté' of a National Cybersecurity Strategy for 2023-2027, with four axes, to be implemented by the CNAC.
Niger adopted a national cybersecurity strategy in December 2022 for 2023-2027, per the report.
The government adopted decrees in October 2025 creating the Centre national de cybersécurité (CNAC) as a public administrative establishment and approving its statutes.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that Niger's government adopted decrees in October 2025 creating the National Cybersecurity Centre (CNAC) and approving its statutes, as a public administrative establishment to coordinate the national strategy.
Agence Ecofin reports that Niger adopted a National Cybersecurity Strategy in December 2022 for 2023-2027.
